verdict.rationale: DBOS docs are markdown-based and CLI/library-oriented; explicit probes found no interactive API reference on the docs site (openapi.json etc. all 404 at docs.dbos.dev), and the one OpenAPI spec found is a raw machine-readable JSON for the Conductor control plane, not an interactive, runnable-example reference. No evidence of a Swagger UI, try-it-out console, or embedded runnable code examples anywhere in the evidence.
